leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Register the StarRatingComponent as a NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR provider using useExisting and forwardRef()
Implement writeValue() to render the correct number of filled stars when the form sets a value programmatically
Implement registerOnChange() and call the registered callback whenever the user clicks a star
Implement registerOnTouched() and mark the control as touched on the first user interaction
Implement setDisabledState() to visually disable the stars and block click events when the parent form is disabled
Use the widget inside a Reactive Form with formControlName and verify that patchValue() updates the displayed stars
Add hover-preview behaviour (highlight stars on hover before click) using @HostListener without breaking the form contract
